items.docs: Retrieves a bearer token to authorize requests. Client id and secret should be supplied as [Basic HTTP Authorization header](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Headers/Authorization#basic_authentication_2). The token retrieved has an expiration time and can be requested a limited number of times per day.
